name: Ship PR Until Green
description: Push, open PR, read CI with gh, fix blockers, until checks green.
kickoff:
Start the "Ship PR Until Green" loop.
Goal: PR open with all CI checks passing
Max iterations: 10
Between iterations run: gh pr checks
Exit when: all PR checks success
Orientation: read the linked ticket to confirm branch scope and acceptance criteria.
Step 1: Confirm branch and open or update PR.

loop_contract.name: Ship PR Until Green
loop_contract.goal: PR open with all CI checks passing
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Verify branch, commits, and diff against target branch. Ensure local checks pass before push.

steps.name: Confirm branch state
steps.instruction: Verify branch, commits, and diff against target branch. Ensure local checks pass before push.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Confirm branch state' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Push and open PR
steps.instruction: Push branch. Open or update PR with summary, test plan, and linked ticket. Use gh CLI if available.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep

failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Push and open PR' completed with evidence.
steps.other_tool: GitHub CLI (gh pr create / gh pr view)

steps.name: Read CI status

steps.name: Fix CI blockers
